title: Nifty Tangy Jamaican Potato Burger
description: A festive, tangy burger featuring chewy potato buns and a bright jerk seasoning, perfect for a nut-free friendly lunch.
instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash them with a fork or potato masher.
Stir in the Jamaican jerk seasoning, lime zest, lime juice, brown sugar, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Fold in the breadcrumbs until the mixture holds together but remains moist.
Divide the mixture into four equal portions and shape each into a patty about 1/2 inch thick.
Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Cook the patties for 4 to 5 minutes on each side, or until they develop a golden crust.
While the patties finish, toast the potato buns lightly on a grill or in a toaster oven.
Assemble each burger by placing the patty on a bun and topping with lettuce, tomato, and a drizzle of spicy mayo.
